name: Sea (Paragon Hag Family)
body:
Although many harshly judge hags’ appearance, the sea hags are considered sickeningly ugly even by other hags. Their families turn this revulsion to their advantage, along with their mastery of the sea.

Family Spells: obscuring mist (3rd), fog cloud (6th), aqueous orb (9th), cause disease (12th), suffocation (15th), fluid form (18th)
Ritual Spells–Intimidate: control water (5th), mirage arcana (7th), symbol of fear (9th), sympathetic* suffocation (11th), symbol of death (13th), elemental swarm (water only) (15th), extended tsunami (17th), anchored* antipathy (19th)
Family Powers: Sea hags’ families grow more repulsive and more closely tied to the sea as they grow in power.
Sickening Appearance (Su)

Whenever a living creature within 15 feet attacks you or targets you with a harmful or damaging spell or effect, that creature must succeed at a Fortitude save or be sickened for one minute. Creatures can attack while averting their eyes from you, but that grants you total concealment against their attacks. Once a creature has made a successful save, it’s immune to your appearance for 24 hours. The DC of the save is 10 + 1/2 your paragon hag level + your Charisma modifier.

Evil Eye (Su)

At 4th level, you may use evil eye as the witch hex of the same name, except that you use Charisma in place of Intelligence for determining duration and the DC of the save is 10 + 1/2 your paragon hag level + your Charisma modifier. The penalty from the evil eye increases at 8th level as normal.

Aquatic Hag (Ex)

At 8th level, you may breathe underwater freely and gain a swim speed of 30’. At 16th level, these benefits extend to your coven.

Revenge of Vanity (Ex)

At 12th level, when you attack a creature sickened by your appearance or subject to your evil eye, you may add your Charisma bonus to hit and damage.

Staggering Eye (Su)

At 16th level, whenever a target fails its Will save against your evil eye, they must also attempt a Fortitude save against the same DC. If they fail that save as well, they are staggered by a sense of nebulous unease for the duration of the evil eye. This is a fear effect.

Legendary Family

Upon reaching 20th level, when a creature fails its Fortitude save against your sickening appearance, they are instead nauseated for the duration and must succeed at a Will save against the same DC or go permanently mad as the insanity spell.
